note: No entry: the repository holds no record of a skill invocation with its client, task, tokens or time, and result. Static validation of tools/skills does not close this gate, and entries are added only from a real session with measured values.

fields.client: client application and version that ran the session
fields.tokens: measured tokens, or null when time_seconds is present
fields.time_seconds: measured elapsed seconds, or null when tokens is present
fields.evidence: repository path or commit that lets a reviewer check the record
